thread.text:
Today: Incline Bench got two sets at the prescribed 65kg (8, 8) before jumping to 70kg × 8, then dropping to 50kg × 12 — the 4×5-8 @ 65kg wasn't completed as written, so the 67.5kg trigger doesn't apply even though both 65kg sets hit 8. Pull-Up shows a single set, bodyweight × 10, well short of the 3×AMRAP @ 5kg the prescription called for. Chest Fly reached 65kg × 12, 12 before the third set fell to 8 — the 10-12 band wasn't held across all three. Lateral Raise hit 8kg × 16, 16, 16. Reverse Fly stood in for Face Pull again, as on 09-21 — a rotate swap, not a comparable number. Right lat read 1/10, clean green.

Trend: Pull-up totals were strong across the last two logged sessions — 33 reps on 09-21, 27 on 09-24 — both clearing the bar that just earned the 5kg reload. Today's 10, all in one set, breaks that run sharply. Incline Bench's 70kg × 8 is a number that hasn't appeared before, ahead of where the anchor currently sits. Lateral Raise's 16, 16, 16 breaks a four-session stall at 15, 15, 15 running from 09-11 to 09-26 — closer to the 20-hold target. Chest Fly has now missed the clean 10-12 band on the third set twice running, 09-21 and today, so the load holds at 65kg.

Right lat: 1/10, a clean green, but Upper A carries no row work, so it doesn't add to the right iso-lateral row's count. Thursday's session is the next chance to get a reading during the actual set.

Next session: Upper B, Thu 1 Oct. Pull-up leads at slot 1, three sets stopping two short of failure. Iso Lateral Row: left holds 60kg, right stays at 55kg — rate the pain during the set itself, since three greens there earns the right side its next +2.5kg.

Question: What happened with pull-ups today — cut to one set for a reason, or is that everything that was done? It changes whether Thursday's slot-1 pull-up should be treated as normal or dialled back.
